description: Card — THE CONTAINER PRIMITIVE, one card, everything else is assembly (EDS 1.0's philosophy, and the team's own architecture: their showcase cards all compose a bare _Card Container). Neutral surface with a subtle outline; interactivity is the MARKUP's fact, not a prop — an <a> or <button> card affords, a <div> card sits still. Plain (uncorrected) inset: no text to compensate for.
notes: v0.2.0 (Victor 2026-08-31): tones DELETED (a 'danger card' was a banner in a costume — the banner carries tone messaging; the team's cards are neutral-only too) and elevation DELETED (cards sit, they don't float; the team dropped it as well). The outline is adopted from the team's cards — but bound to border-neutral-subtle, our STATIC tier, not their interactive-namespace token: a resting card is a static surface (the banner rule). INTERACTIVE BY ELEMENT: hover (the team's nice hover shadow via elevation-low, plus a strengthened border) is gated on :is(a, button) — no data-interactive attribute; the markup already says it. Focus ring needs no gate (a div cannot match :focus-visible) and stays REFUSED in Figma as always. Figma: State=Default/Hover only, and a placeholder frame named 'Slot' for teams to fill with anything (the Plugin API cannot create true SLOT nodes yet — upgrade it by hand in the UI when it can, or when Figma allows). Container rule: md-squared 16 inset, and vertical-md 16 gap between slotted children. The rich product cards (the baseline-grid card in Victor's pen) are DEMO-LAYER compositions on this primitive, not variants of it.

aria.interactive: an interactive card IS an <a> or <button> with the class — one action per card; do not nest controls inside a button card
